name: Thorn-E: Virtual Passion
source:
It was a normal night for Thorne, go out to a sting hole and find the answer to his life at the bottom of a glass. Until she walked in; her curves, her lips, her chests and only two things filled the air from her: high end perfume and trouble.

[From [url=http://lessonofpassion.wikia.com/wiki/Thorn-E:_Virtual_Passion]Lesson of Passion Wikia[/url]]
